findings.note: The bundle discloses that all five of T-005's deliverables landed in commit 45dda57f, a T-001 commit whose message admits it 'spans 23 paths beyond T-001's own Planned Files', and that the T-005 report was an unfinished stub with Status never past Planned until 2026-08-18. Stating this explicitly rather than assuming either way: none of those properties can be confirmed or refuted from this bundle. For a high-risk, security-sensitive, cross-epic-blast-radius task this is an insufficient review package.

The two rows cite the same evidence file and differ only in which runtime's red/green pair they point at. There is no distinct unit-test layer; the two required checks are one suite run relabelled by runtime, which overstates the breadth of independent verification.
